marketResearchScope: Public web search queries, not location-locked Google US top-10 snapshots; rankings and SERP feature prevalence not independently verified.
method: 15 individually searched value-specific queries. Record one independently observed related competitor landing for each and actual visible feature. Exact-value-page means the returned page's title or heading includes the value; generic means the value appears in a table/example. Does not assert any organic position or market volume.
dataSourceSeparation: Observed rival page/feature only. Original Semrush Volume/KD remain historical user export, not refreshed by these searches.
